article.headline: Haggerty scores 29 points, Shelley adds 19 as Texas A&M rallies to beat TCU 97-92 in OT
article.description: — PJ Haggerty scored 29 points for Texas A&M and Jalen Shelley scored eight of his 19 points in overtime, and the undefeated Aggies rallied from a 12-point halftime deficit to beat TCU 97-92 on Thursday night.
article.linkText: Haggerty scores 29 points, Shelley adds 19 as Texas A&M rallies to beat TCU 97-92 in OT

categories.description: Texas A&M Aggies @ TCU Horned Frogs

event.description: Texas A&M Aggies @ TCU Horned Frogs

keywords: Texas A&M Aggies @ TCU Horned Frogs
article.story: FORT WORTH, Texas -- — PJ Haggerty scored 29 points for Texas A&M and Jalen Shelley scored eight of his 19 points in overtime, and the undefeated Aggies rallied from a 12-point halftime deficit to beat TCU 97-92 on Thursday night. The Aggies ended a four-game losing streak against TCU and are 6-0 for the first time since the 2017-18 season. TCU led most of the second half until Jordan Pope's layup gave the Aggies a 79-78 lead with 2:09 left in regulation, their first lead since 11:32 remained in the first half. With 34 seconds left, Shelley made 1 of 2 free throws to tie it at 81. Texas A&M forced a turnover but Haggerty missed a 3 to send it to overtime. Shelley hit a 3-pointer to give Texas A&M a 90-87 advantage with 2:44 remaining in OT and the Aggies led the rest of the way. Shelley was 2 of 2 from distance and made 2 of 4 free throws in the extra period. Mackenzie Mgbako scored 15 points and Zach Clemence added 14 for Texas A&M. Pope finished with 12 points. Brock Harding scored 18 points to lead six in double-figure scoring for TCU (4-1). The Aggies trailed 51-39 at halftime but opened the second half on a 22-13 surge to cut the deficit to 64-61. Pope scored eight points and Haggerty added six that included a dunk during the stretch. Texas A&M leads the series 89-78. Up next Texas A&M: The Aggies face Xavier on Wednesday in the Battle 4 Atlantis. TCU: The Horned Frogs play No. 17 Miami in the Players Era 16 on Tuesday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
